notes.title: Egg-citing updates 🐣: Pip Pepper Park Planner Demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187573/a285012d00534f93292bfdb69c0d6ba390aa855e.gif[/img]

[b]Hello and happy new year![/b]

[i]Merci beacoo[/i] for all your support for [b]Pip Pepper Park Planner[/b] so far. We are incredibly touched that you have played the early demo for our game and are excited about its further development.

We’ve been [i]pecking[/i] away at the details and have now updated the demo to include a number of bug fixes, UI improvements, a pause menu, minor performance optimization, quality of life updates -and new character portraits! - Go check it out on the demo's Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3208030/Pip_Pepper_Park_Planner__Demo/

We are buzzing with excitement to continue development on the full game, and to share all the [i]egg-citing[/i] things we’ve been working on!

If you would like to stay updated on the latest news and progress on the development of the game, please follow us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/pippeppergame.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/pippeppergame]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/3hnedg2mKj]Discord[/url].  

-[i]The development team [/i]
